changelog_v110_items: Custom cover and title support (manual overrides).
Larger default window size for optimal layout.
changelog_v100_items: Official rename to Machete PS5 Backup Manager.
changelog_v020_items: Incorporation of native deletion prevention system (Native Dialog).
UI restructuring with Cyberpunk styling and dark mode.
Native support for 11 languages with dynamic switching.
changelog_v010_items: Proof of concept. Asynchronous file reading.
Basic initial connection with SerialStation API.
changelog_v200_items: Nueva interfaz Cyberpunk (Tarjetas 3D, Consola Hacker, Disco Holográfico).
Motor I/O asíncrono impulsado por Tokio.
Cálculo de hashes Blake3 Anti Bit-Rot.
Cálculo dinámico del tamaño total del directorio.
changelog_v123_items: Corregido error de '0 GB' en el peso de carpetas.
Añadido cálculo total de GB en la barra superior.
update_none: أنت تستخدم أحدث إصدار. لا توجد تحديثات متاحة.
update_error: تعذر التحقق من التحديثات. يرجى المحاولة لاحقاً.
changelog_v202_items: In-app auto-updater: checks for new versions from GitHub Releases.
Download & install updates directly from the app with progress bar.
Dynamic version display in About section (no more hardcoded versions).
All updater UI fully translated to 12 languages.
